Economic Times via Medial — CRED FY25 revenue rises 16%, losses narrow

marketing_spend.derivation: A specific FY25 marketing-spend figure was not located. Historical disclosed figures show a steady decline as a share of revenue: ₹976 crore in FY22 and ₹713 crore in FY23 (down 27% YoY). Triangulated FY25 range of ₹500-700 crore assumes the same declining trend continued as CRED's revenue grew and the company matured past its aggressive early-growth ad blitz (e.g. the Rahul Dravid campaigns).

business_updates.headline: CRED's FY25 revenue rises 16% to ₹2,735 crore as losses narrow to ₹1,457 crore
